title: Organizing Redux Code
overview: A proper Redux structure keeps application logic organized and makes the code easier to maintain.

title: Keep State Minimal
overview: Only store necessary data in Redux. Derived or temporary values should usually be calculated inside components.

example.title: State Management
example.content:
Store:
User data
Authentication status

Component:
Input values
Temporary UI state

title: Avoid Direct State Mutation
overview: Redux state should not be modified directly. Always create updates through reducers or Redux Toolkit logic.

title: Use Selectors
overview: Selectors provide a reusable way to access specific parts of Redux state and keep components cleaner.

title: Redux Performance Optimization
overview: Proper state design, selectors, and avoiding unnecessary updates help improve Redux application performance.

example.title: Performance Tips
example.content:
✔ Split slices
✔ Use memoized selectors
✔ Avoid unnecessary re-renders

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned Redux best practices including code organization, state design, selectors, immutability, and performance optimization.
